name: Mission To Space with Francis Bourgeois
summary: The social media star and trainspotter trains as an astronaut with one of the leading companies in commercial space flight, and under the guidance of Tim Peake.

name: Batal Al Alam
summary: After losing the world championship, Africa's boxing champion becomes a professional bodyguard seeking a second chance. Assigned to protect Donia, the daughter of a cunning businessman with hidden wealth and debts to a gambling lord. Salah and Donia embark on fiery chases, uncover secrets, and the hero finds love and redemption.

name: Zvaces se Varvara
summary: Milena, a young girl who experienced deep suffering and seeks help and consolation from God. She can't even ask for happiness. God agrees to help her by giving her the name Varvara so nobody could ever recognize or hurt her again.

name: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny TV Movie 1-4
A Testa Alta - Il Coraggio di una Donna
summary: In a small provincial town, a very topical issue is being addressed head-on, today, it is easy to see one's private life put on the streets and judged in a few hours, between real damage and the long wave of online comments.

name: Take Charge of My Heart
summary: An electrifying romantic comedy about a man whose artificial heart is running out of battery and a woman who has the power to recharge him. Baek Ho Rang, a third-generation chaebol heir leads one of the nation's top conglomerates' resorts, a gifted businessman he is skilled in strategizing and execution, and is a strong candidate to take over the group's leadership role — if not for his unspoken secret and only weakness: beneath his impeccable facade beats an artificial heart. Amid fierce power struggles with his heart battery running low, he encounters Na Bo Bae, a miraculous woman capable of recharging his battery. In an unplanned move, he offers her a contract she can't refuse. Na Bo Bae is a screenwriter with a looming deadline to finish a romance screenplay before her contract expires. Stuck by lightning as a child, she has electrical currents coursing through her body, making it impossible for her to even hold hands with someone she likes. When she meets Baek Ho Rang, the only person not shocked by touching her, she finally has the opportunity to jumpstart her love life.

name: Чат
summary:
Four friends – Kristina, Dasha, Natasha and Nastya - became friends in their native Yekaterinburg, but have been living completely different lives for a long time. Kristina moved to Moscow and became a real TV star, Dasha married a St. Petersburg football player, Nastya works as a doctor in Sochi, and Natasha remained in Yekaterinburg.
But the heroines still found a way to always stay together: their chat. For them, this is an opportunity to openly share their experiences, support each other and go through life side by side, even being thousands of kilometers away.

name: Тётка
summary: Sassy and selfish Margot has built herself the most comfortable lifestyle possible – she works as a stripper, hangs out with her friends, and dates a total loser just like her. But all the fun goes to hell when Margot suddenly becomes the guardian of two spoiled nephews – fifteen-year-old Polina and fourteen-year-old Lyosha. The irresponsible stripper will have to grow up in a hurry, and the children, accustomed to wealth, will have to adapt to ordinary life.

name: Polskie Prywatne Zbrodnie
summary: Series shows the shocking murders that have happened in recent years in Poland. Each episode is dedicated to a different, fact-based crime that seemed like an accidental death.

name: Av måneskinn gror det ingenting
summary:
Av måneskinn gror det ingenting is an award-winning Norwegian drama series in three parts airing in October 1987.
Based on the iconic 1947 Torborg Nedraas novel by the same name, the series depicts a young woman, Clara, and her battle towards a gruesome abortion in the late 1940s.

name: Medmenneske
summary: Medmenneske is a Norwegian drama series.

name: Les brumes
summary: Anna, a mute young woman and the sole survivor, is urgently extracted to a windswept Atlantic island. There lives Victor Coste, a police officer who has exiled himself to the other side of the world. Cut off from everything, he accepts one last mission: to get Anna to talk, identify the killer, and prevent him from striking again. But when the world's densest fog rolls in, a race against time begins, as the island itself turns into a trap.

name: The Astrology House
summary: The Astrology House follows the cosmically intertwined lives of Rini and Margot. When Rini invites Margot and her family-and-friend group to vacation at her astrology retreat, long-held resentments, secrets and lies boil over, culminating in death.

name: Candy
summary: Nuannuan—the girl she once left behind in her youth—reenters her life as an assistant. Under the pressure of fame and public scrutiny, the two escape the city to join a rural reality show. Meanwhile, veteran manager Si Han and superstar Jiang Wan are locked in a fierce game of love and power, entangled in workplace rivalry and unresolved past feelings. Between tenderness and cruelty, sincerity and calculation, two GL love stories unfold against the unforgiving reality of the entertainment industry.

name: Foul Play with Anthony Davis
summary: Foul Play with Anthony Davis pairs elite athletes with elaborate pranks, giving them one chance to pull off their mischievous plans or foul out trying.

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Gaiden: Rimuru's Glamorous Life as a Teacher
summary:
Rimuru's Glamorous Life as a Teacher follows Rimuru as he's summoned to the Freedom Academy in the Kingdom of Ingrassia and unexpectedly assigned to teach a small class of children whose lives are in danger. Each child carries an unstable spirit that's slowly consuming them from the inside, and unless someone intervenes, they won't survive into adulthood. Rimuru takes responsibility for them, stepping into the role of a mentor while searching for a way to stabilize their powers before time runs out.

Across the trilogy, he trains them, protects them, and gradually earns their trust, all while uncovering the truth behind their condition. The story blends lighthearted school-life comedy with a surprisingly emotional rescue mission, showing a side of Rimuru that's more nurturing and personal than in the main series.

This OAD series were bundled with manga volumes 14-16.

previousepisode.name: Gaiden: Rimuru no Karei na Kyoushi Seikatsu - Sono 3

name: Secret Genius
summary: It is estimated that there are thousands of people in the UK with the brains of a genius, from all walks of life and backgrounds – who don't even know it. Secret Genius will see Alan Carr and Susie Dent test Britain's brainpower like never before to uncover the country's most gifted and unsung minds.

name: Vote for Me
summary: Vote for Me aims to find an "ordinary" member of the public to stand as an independent candidate for the 2005 UK election.

name: 999: What Happened Next
summary: Series following the investigators who must hunt for the truth and bring the guilty to justice.

name: Yona of the Dawn: Kou Ryuu Zeno Kako-hen
summary: In another time and place, Son Hak and the dragons banter as they hold a drinking contest. As they start to doze off one-by-one, Zeno dreams of his past, where his abilities and experiences, both as a person and as the Yellow Dragon, are revealed.

previousepisode.name: Kou Ryuu Zeno Kako-hen Kouhen: Akai Hoshi ga Noboru

name: Arifureta: The Miraculous Meeting and the Phantasmagorical Adventure
summary:
After the capture, Hajime was worried about the farewell to Myuu that would occur when the trip resumed. Hajime and his friends were talking about "The Seven Great Legends of Erisen" as a memory before they left for the trip, but all of them were missed. However, in the final seventh adventure, he encounters a mysterious giant creature and is blown into the world of a devastated city! Hajime, who started to search for the stray Myuu, fulfills a miraculous encounter there.

This two-part sub-story was released on blu-ray set volume 1 and 2 respectively.

name: The Blood of Youth: Quest of Heroic Hearts
summary: The legendary Chosen's Sword returns, shaking the Jianghu. Cold, aloof Wei Gui sets out to uncover his past, meeting passionate Lei Lingze at a mountain temple. Joined by the mysterious Ye Zhixin and storyteller Hua Xiaohua, they hunt for the sword. But when Ye Zhixin is revealed as the hidden leader of a dark sect, their bond shatters. Facing betrayal, loss, and chaos, Wei Gui and Lei Lingze unite their blades to cut through the conspiracy and defend justice.

name: Doktor: Başka Hayatta
summary: After surviving a severe attack, Prof. Dr. İnan Kural, the distinguished chief physician of Umutpark Medical Foundation Hospital, returns to life with no memory of the past 12 years. He finds himself in a world that feels completely unfamiliar. The years he lived are far from even being memories for him, and he struggles to recognize even himself. Surrounded by unfamiliar relationships, incomprehensible bonds, and unanswered questions, he is forced to rebuild his life from scratch.

name: Dirty
summary: Trainee Detective Eva Bennett returns to Manchester and joins a new homicide investigation run by her fearsome estranged mother - the legendary Detective Chief Inspector Lois Mercer. As they navigate their complicated relationship and long-buried truths resurface, Eva starts to uncover Lois' crimes, forcing an impossible choice between justice and blood.

name: The Assembly Ireland
summary: A bold and heartfelt interview series where autistic and neurodivergent hosts take the lead, asking the questions everyone else avoids. With honesty, curiosity, and zero filters, no topic is off-limits, resulting in raw, funny, and deeply human conversations that challenge assumptions and redefine how stories are told.

name: Trophy Wife: Murder on Safari
summary: Explores the mysterious death of Bianca Rudolph on an African hunting trip. Accused is wealthy Pittsburgh-area dentist Larry Rudolph.

name: Chong Hui 87 Zhi Zhang Shang Ming Zhu
The Remarried Empress
summary: Beloved Empress Navier of the Eastern Empire has built and led a prosperous land alongside her husband, Emperor Sovieshu. One day her world is shattered when the emperor brings Rashta, a runaway slave, back to the palace with the intention of making her his mistress. But even as the threat of a broken future looms over her, Navier refuses to let her emotions sway her, and when Prince Heinrey, a rival leader of the Western Kingdom, shows interest in her, Navier will make a life-changing decision to rewrite her destiny.

name: Vision & Destiny
summary: Dr Jordan B Peterson draws upon his extensive research and relatable real-life experiences to illustrate how to develop attainable goals for intimate relationships, meaningful friendships, and your career. Transform the chaotic potential of the future into actuality — with a vision.

name: Real History with Matt Walsh
summary: Real History with Matt Walsh confronts the lies used to rewrite America's past. It challenges decades of propaganda, questions untouchable stories, and reexamines the history generations were taught to reject.

previousepisode.name: The Real History of Civil Rights Part 2: The Looting of America

name: Speed Kills
summary: They can accelerate faster than a Ferrari, strike with 10 times the g-force of a space shuttle, and outmaneuver a fighter jet. These are the fastest animals on Earth, and they use their speed to lethal effect in some of the planet's most combative environments. Take a journey across deserts, dense jungles, and murky lagoons, and see how predators and prey run, swim, and fly for their lives. We capture every movement in high definition, at 1,000 frames-per-second, so you won't miss one graphic detail of this fast-paced and often violent world.

name: Pura Sangre
summary: At La Galana, the family estate of the Marquises of Monteclaro, the most valuable stallion is found poisoned along with several foals from the stable. This event shakes the apparent tranquillity of the family and triggers an investigation that threatens to uncover a complex web of buried secrets, crossed loyalties, economic tensions and unresolved wounds.

name: Incredible Games
summary: Fantasy challenges in a futuristic building with a humanoid lift.

name: Dona Beja
summary: After being assaulted and shamed by society, a 19th-century woman retaliates by opening a luxurious brothel, defying norms and rising as a powerful courtesan.

name: A Knight in the Making
summary: Explore A Knight of the Seven Kingdom in this rivering Look at how HBO's newest show in th universe was brought to life.

name: Dealen Met Coke
summary: For eight weeks, Eric Goens explores every corner of the international drug trade.

name: Love Hurts
summary: Wenika is a young woman who has managed to rise above her middle-class beginnings. She has established her cosmetic brand with the help of her best friends, Maynee and Banthao. However, when she yearns to grow and expand her business, Thirakit, a young investor from Malaysia comes into her life and is ready to invest. This is everything Wenika has been looking for. The problem — Thirakit is the young playboy who slept with and dumped her best friend, Maynee. He's also mysterious and showing likeness for Wenika and what's worse he seems to be plotting to take over Wenika's company with his 'aunt.'

name: The Boy Next World: Heikousekai no Koibito
summary: The ordinary daily life of Yotsuba Fu, a college student with zero romantic experience, is suddenly turned upside down one day. The senior admired by everyone on campus, Kogami Sara, abruptly tells him that he is someone who came from a parallel world, and that "we are lovers", declaring it unilaterally. Confused by this sudden confession from Sara, with whom he has never even exchanged words before, Fu nevertheless finds himself gradually drawn to him. However, he soon begins to suffer from the inner conflict that he himself is not the Fu whom Sara loved in that parallel world. At the same time, Sara is also carrying a major secret of his own… Guided together by the threads of fate, what path of love will the two ultimately choose?

name: Frozen Valentine
summary: Two former classmates, one an heiress with a past crush and the other a rising star model, reunite when they're cast in a Girls' Love series. Pingrak—formerly a nerd, now a beautiful, ultra-rich heiress to a massive department store empire—once had a secret crush on P'Charm, her former ice-cold senior and a school star. Today, she's a rising model. Back then, she brought her horrible sadness. From a love that was once one-sided between them, the two are suddenly thrown together as the leads in a Girls' Love series.

name: Госзащита
summary: Businessman Roman Sokolov and his partner fall into the hands of law enforcement agencies on suspicion of fraud on a particularly large scale. However, Roman made a deal with the investigation in advance: as a result, his accomplice is sent to jail, and he and his daughter Alice are transported to Blagoveshchensk under the witness protection program. Now they are the "Khomyakov family", and their safety is provided by Major Sveta and Captain Grisha. Roman will have to play the role of an exemplary family man, live in a "fake" police family and establish relations with his daughter Alice, who is not at all happy about the move.

name: Glitter & Gold: Ice Dancing
summary: From dazzling outfits to spectacular routines, this sparkling reality series showcases the passionate, dramatic world of competitive ice dance.

name: Very Lost in LA
summary: An Austrian influencer moves to Los Angeles chasing fame and fortune, but soon finds himself caught in one mishap after another -- proving that in LA, it's easier to get lost than to get famous.

name: UFO: POV
summary: UFO: POV is a hard-hitting UFO series led by renowned expert Chris Rutkowski. Each episode investigates a real unexplained encounter, combining eyewitness testimony, on-the-ground investigation and decades of research to uncover what really happened.

name: Platoon 24/7: Preparing for War
summary:
As war rages in Eastern Europe, the British Army is readying its infantry platoons for action. These platoons – 30 strong units of soldiers who eat, sleep and fight alongside each other – are the backbone of the British Army.

This series follows one newly assembled platoon in The Rifles, the British Army's largest infantry regiment, preparing for possible frontline deployment. Filmed over six brutal months, they must develop soldiering skills to compete with a battle-hardened enemy and grow into a band of brothers so tight they will lay down their lives for each other.

name: #HATETAG
summary: 10 short stories about social media and bullying.

name: El Mochaorejas
summary: El Mochaorejas follows a journalist who, through archives and testimonies, reconstructs the rise of a legendary kidnapper and the web of fear and secrets that still marks Mexico.

name: mofusand animation
summary: Shark Meow is an orange tabby kitty who wears a shark suit. A little clumsy and always taking things at their own cozy pace, but every day with their best kitty friends — and the rescued baby kitty, Little Meow — is filled with unexpected little mishaps and sweet adventures. A sunny warm spot in the park, the sparkle of the sea, steam rising from freshly roasted sweet potatoes, the fluttery feeling of the first snowfall… These small everyday moments fill their world with warmth and delight. You can't help but smile and think, "So true!" A soft and snuggly kitty anime that brings joy to everyday moments.

name: Killer In The House
summary: This chilling true crime series delves into the UK's most extraordinary cases, including a passionate affair that led to a double murder and a body buried in a teacher's garden.

previousepisode.name: The Murder of Lesley Howell and Trevor Buchanan

name: Hildur
summary: 'Nordic Blue' crime drama HILDUR, based on the best-selling novels by Satu Rämö. A surfing female detective fights against time to confront a serial killer in the fjords of Iceland while unraveling the mystery of her long-lost sisters.

name: Loveless Heroine
summary: After falling into a body of water, Pennueng is transported into the body of a literary heroine she once studied in a textbook, famed for her misfortune. This heroine was fought over by two men and sentenced to death, charged as a "woman of two hearts." Her only chance to escape her fate is to flee far from these two men. Whether it's the one we love or the one who loves us, this "Wanthong" wants neither of them!!

name: Esa noche
summary: During a family vacation in the Dominican Republic, Elena accidentally hits a man with her car. Desperate and frightened, she calls her sisters, Paula and Cris, asking for help. Upon arrival, they must decide how to handle the accident, as they cannot bear the thought of their younger sister going to jail, leaving her only child without a mother. How far will they be willing to go to help protect their family?

name: Чадо из ада - Предки
summary:
Teenagers have been reformed — we take care of their parents!
Meet the premiere on the TV channel "Yu" — "Child from hell. The ancestors." The characters who were once young majors turned to our reality show with a request to send their moms and dads for re-education. And we couldn't refuse them...

name: Reality Check: Inside America's Next Top Model
summary: Models, judges and "ANTM" insiders — including Tyra Banks — look back at the reality show's complicated legacy in this eye-opening documentary series.

name: Wild Heartbeat
summary: Award winning actress Zhan Lu takes in her former patron, Yi Heng, at the lowest point of his life, turning their relationship completely upside down. What begins as a transaction slowly grows into genuine love as the two stand together against public scrutiny and family opposition in the world of fame and power. As the truth comes to light, Yi Heng's prestigious background is revealed, yet he willingly chooses to be "kept" for the sake of love. Meanwhile, Zhan Lu discovers her true self through both her career and romance, and the two ultimately find their happy ending together.

name: The Supreme Body Refining Master
summary: Ye Cangxuan, a supreme cultivator of the Body Refining Realm, was once invincible in the mortal world. He easily passed the Ascension Trial and ascended to the Immortal World. There, he learned that his homeland—the Nine Skies Continent—was on the brink of destruction. Without hesitation, Ye Cangxuan chose to return. At the same time, the Six Sects were collapsing. Demons and devils from the Outer Lands were poised to invade, and their spies had already infiltrated the Nine Skies Continent. Determined to change his homeland's fate, Ye Cangxuan embarked on a grueling quest. He reunited the Six Sects, broke into the Barbaric Wastes, wiped out demons and devils, and challenged the immortals themselves. In the end, he stood against the Sky itself.

name: Sugar and Lies
summary: On the eve of her engagement, Ding Dang unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Chen Aming, only to find he has changed his name to Yu Kun and assumed a new identity. To heal Chen Aming's personality disorder caused by a failed experiment, Ding Dang and her friends secretly devise a "Sugarcoat" plan. It aims to guide him in confronting past traumas and breaking free from fractured emotions and memories.

name: Dark and Dawn
summary: Ye Xiao'ai, an aspiring designer, and Zhuang Lili, a model fleeing domestic abuse, cross paths by chance and form a friendship. Xiao'ai helps Lili stand up to her husband Li Jin, while Lili helps Xiao'ai resolve the emotional entanglements with her "brother-in-law" Lin Sen. In their fierce but loving sisterhood, both chase their dreams and ultimately embrace a brand new life.

name: Visage and Soul
summary: After losing her memory, Qiao Xiaomi is targeted by her brother, Zhiwei, at their father's funeral. Just then, her fiancé Qin Yu, who vanished three years ago, suddenly returns and comes to her rescue. With Qin Yu's help, Xiaomi's memories begin to point to a deadly fire. But Qin Yu's return was actually orchestrated by Zhiwei. As the truth comes to light, their love, built on a lie, faces its greatest test.

name: The Naive Leader
summary: The rich but naive Fan Sha'er is buried alive by his own father for raiding a grain depot. After escaping, he meets Xiugu and her father, who run a hotpot restaurant. Persecuted by Master Huo and guided by the mystic Xuanjizi, he accidentally joins a bandit gang. Rising to become its leader, he forms a sworn brotherhood to uphold justice. After killing Japanese invaders, his group is integrated into the formal army. Through battlefield achievements and strict discipline, including banning gambling, he eventually grows into a division commander leading troops against the Japanese.

name: A Summer Meant for Us
summary: In the late summer of the 1980s, an unexpected event intertwines the fates of the feuding Zheng and Wang families. After losing her factory job, Wang Yingrong, the second daughter of the Wang family, struggles in pig farming before finding success in vinegar brewing, all with the help of Zheng Minjiang, the eldest son of the Zheng family. As they work together, affection quietly grows between them. In the end, the longstanding rift between the two families heals, turning a generational feud into a bond of marriage.

name: Neighbors
summary: Neighbors examines stories of absurd, outrageous, and dramatic real-life residential conflicts from a wide range of larger-than-life characters across the United States, opening a verité portal into the lives of contemporary Americans. Each episode introduces a new set of neighbors in the heat of their grievances, uncovering spirited disputes about property lines, animal ownership, and even a yellow Speedo. Directors and emerging talents Harrison Fishman and Dylan Redford filmed for over two years, traveling across the country and fully immersing themselves in these neighbors' lives to capture an unfiltered and intimate portrait of everyday people and document the fundamentally American pursuits of life, liberty, and property.

name: The 300 Loyal Ghosts
summary: As the Deputy Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, Zhang Yi harbors a bloody vendetta, biding his time in silence. Outwardly, he joins forces with Shen Youzhi of the Imperial Guards to track down criminals, their relationship evolving from confrontation to cooperation. In secret, however, he is the mastermind pulling the strings of revenge. When all conspiracies converge towards an end, a meticulously crafted trap for justice suddenly springs shut. The fates of all involved collide violently in this moment, culminating in a final choice amidst a labyrinth of espionage and shadows.

name: The Glory Fades
summary: Su Yunian infiltrates the glittering, decadent world of "The Heart of Opulence" to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, only to be swept into a deadly power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jiasheng. She soon learns her sister was silenced for possessing crucial evidence. As danger mounts, betrayed by her closest friend, framed by the top courtesan, and relentlessly pursued by Nie Feng, Su Yunian walks a razor's edge between enmity and alliance with Tu Jiasheng. In this realm of illusions, every glimmer hides a blood-stained lie.

name: Un meurtre (presque) parfait
summary: Laure Mondo's specialty is the perfect crime. A successful novelist, perched on dizzying heels, Laure cultivates her mystery and deadly humor. The complete opposite of his assistant: Pica. Messy hair, loud laughter, colorful t-shirts, she is struggling to satisfy her whimsical boss. This mismatched duo will, however, be confronted with their first investigation: Yves Cayatte, boss of an international luxury group, is found dead in the swimming pool of his sumptuous Corsican villa. The police conclude it was an accident. But Laure doesn't believe it. Yves was a monster and everyone in his family wanted him dead. Sniffing the material for her next novel, she is determined to discover the truth, helped by the turbulent Pica.

name: Quest for the Lost Vikings
summary: David and Jo, members of the world-famous Explorer's Club, are on a mission to explore the truth about their Viking heritage, and they are using their years of experience to uncover the truth about Viking exploration of the Americas.

name: Miracle
summary: This series uncovers real-life miracles that defy logic, science, and skepticism. Each episode is narrated by Bear Grylls and features firsthand accounts, cinematic reenactments, expert insights, and exclusive music videos from top Christian artists.

name: Secrets Of Ancient Structures
summary: Across the globe and throughout history, ancient civilizations erected structures that continue to inspire awe and wonder. But how did they do it? Archaeological finds and new technologies reveal clues to long-enduring mysteries.

previousepisode.name: Thomas komt terecht bij twee vooraanstaande Gentse families

name: Тренер аға
summary: A former boxer with a checkered past returns to his crime-ridden hometown following the death of his estranged father. He inherits a gym and takes on the role of a coach for local teenagers. When he realizes that the gym could offer his protégés a better future than a life of crime, he must let go of his selfish ambitions and work to bring law and order to his city.

name: The Crow Club
summary: A society of outcasts — people who have fallen through the cracks of life, each from a different corner of despair. Those who seem unwanted and unseen come together to take on the strangest jobs that no one else would do — for clients just as strange as they are

name: The Grim Lover
summary: Won, an anesthesiologist, loses his longtime partner, Fah, in a car accident and is wrongly accused of his murder. Overwhelmed by grief and despair, Won decides to end his life. But before losing consciousness, he encounters the Grim Reaper, Sepsawat, who looks exactly like his beloved Fah. Sepsawat refuses to let Won leave this world without his consent and supports him in his fight to prove his innocence.

name: Wild Vacation Rentals
summary: Wild Vacation Rentals during each episode, the friends will explore three of the most enchanting, eccentric and downright bizarre rentals that the country's hottest destinations have to offer, ultimately picking one "must stay" property per episode. With today's endless getaway possibilities, Sherry and D'Arcy will find the top spots that are worth travelers' time and money, sharing the homes' hilariously honest reviews, unbelievable stories straight from the owners, and incredible designs and unique quirks.

name: Britain's Worst Weather Disasters
summary: The most extreme weather events to hit the UK, from devastating floods and ferocious storms to deep-freeze blizzards and record-breaking heat.

name: Kaalipotka
summary: In a gritty urban jungle, four women - Srima, Rani, Rinku, and Minoti - are drawn into chaos after Minoti's husband's freak accident. A cover-up spirals into deceit, murder, and revenge as ex-con Rana and the police hunt them.

name: Breakers
summary: Breakers follows two best friends from the U.S. who go backpacking in Australia and are soon drawn into a seemingly perfect community of surfers led by a charismatic but mysterious figure, Brando.

name: Chasing Love
summary: Song, a hot nerd and food researcher, arranged a one-night stand with a mysterious woman under a strict condition: no strings attached. However, the other party broke the terms, asking for an emotional connection. Song ended the steamy encounter and walked away. But the world really is round. That woman turned out to be Piangrawin—the daughter of the president of the company where Song worked. And Piangrawin wasn't letting go easily. She pursued her with puppy-like devotion, entangling Song's heart and routine with reckless charm. She even claimed she'd already named their future child.

name: BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai
summary: Baki and the strongest Underground Arena fighters face a threat of historical proportions: the resurrected Musashi Miyamoto, Japan's greatest samurai.

name: Hometown Romance
summary: The story follows Sujintra, a woman accustomed to a luxurious lifestyle of cafes, luxury goods, and urban routine. Driven by self-interest, she sets her sights on acquiring a valuable inherited plot of land. Her plans change when she meets Klao, a simple farmer, who responds to her proposal with an unexpected counteroffer: marriage. What begins as disbelief gradually evolves into frequent encounters, challenging Sujintra's assumptions and opening the door to emotional change. As urban comforts give way to long commutes and rural routines, Sujintra finds herself drawn to a life and a person she never expected.

name: The Blank Menu for You
summary: In this quirky eatery, guests place open-ended orders that chefs interpret into custom dishes — a delectable talk show where every story inspires a meal.

previousepisode.name: TABLO 'Elementary School, the Taste of Those Days'

name: Fatal Attraction: I'd Kill To Be You
Redemption Run
summary: A uniquely diverse and eclectic group of Canadian athletes compete with dreams of representing their country on the world stage in one of the most punishing sports of all: bobsleigh

name: WaPo Duisburg
summary: The WaPo Duisburg team investigates at Duisburg Harbor, the world's largest inland port. The investigators solve every case—whether murder, robbery, kidnapping, or blackmail—with honest Ruhr Valley charm, criminalistic finesse, and unusual methods.

name: WaPo Elbe
summary: Illegal salmon fishing, drug dealing, and deadly rivalries: crime is on the rise in the German-Czech border region, which is why a new team from the WaPo (water police) is manning the outpost on the Elbe.

name: Jury Duty Presents: Company Retreat
summary: Anthony, a real temp, is hired at Rockin' Grandma's Hot Sauce (a fake company) for its annual retreat - the final one for the company's CEO Doug before retirement. Doug's son Dougie Jr. struggles to prove his leadership abilities while a polished private-equity team courts the company for acquisition.

name: Sex Criminals
summary: Sex Criminals centers on Suze, a normal girl with an extraordinary ability: when she has sex, she stops time. One night, she meets Jon, who has the same gift. And so they do what any other sex having, time stopping couple would do: they rob banks.

name: Flavortown Food Fight
summary: Flavortown Food Fight long referred to but never before seen, the mythical and delicious Flavortown will be the setting for this multi-round, culinary competition. In each episode, Fieri will welcome three chefs to Flavortown where skills and cooking chops can earn advantages and ultimately a win. Competitors will choose their own adventure as they compete in authentic food establishments ranging from street food carts to neighborhood spots to fast casual eateries and the finest fine dining restaurants in the world. The chefs must be quick on their feet as their culinary knowledge, technical skills, and overall cooking acumen are tested round after round. With restaurant names inspired by Guy's life, the series will deliver everything fans have ever dreamed Flavortown could be. The winner of each episode has a chance to score up to $20,000 in prize money and will return to defend their title against two new chefs the following week.

name: The Chain
summary: A parent learns their child has been kidnapped, and the only way to get them back is to pay a ransom and find another child to abduct.

name: Matkalistim
summary: Aviram, a self-important, rule-dodging sergeant, leads a cushy life at a military Special Ops base. His world is thrown into utter chaos when his son, 19-year-old Rani, unwittingly becomes the new Canteen Commando. Rani's a Walmart version of a young Woody Allen, insecure and with a fear of alpha males, who now finds himself serving under a detestable sergeant (his estranged father), facing surprise drills, misguided mentorship and the most passive-aggressive toastie orders known to man! While trying to survive, Rani looks to win the heart of Naama – a sharp-tongued counter-terrorism clerk with no patience for macho nonsense. In his quest to prove himself to Naama – and maybe, just maybe, to his father – Rani might just discover that courage comes in many forms…even if it's buried under layers of pretzels and PTSD.

name: Mama's Maken Porno
summary: After browsing through several porn websites, the four celebrity mothers become concerned about the content young people encounter online and what the consequences are. They decide to make an ethical porn film themselves, but first they have to investigate the intriguing world of porn.

name: Still Shining
summary: After falling in love as teens, two young adults drift apart — only to reunite 10 years later and confront their heartbreak, growth and new challenges.

name: Les Morin-Perras sous le même toit
summary: Maripier Morin and Jean-Philippe Perras embark on a bold adventure: transforming their house into an intergenerational home.

name: Les Guignols de l'info
summary: Les Guignols de l'info (literally "The News Puppets"), sometimes simply called Les Guignols (Puppets), is a satirical French television show of puppets, broadcasted since August 29, 1988 on the channel Canal+. A parody of a newscast, the show is a caricature of the political world, the media, personalities or more generally of French society and the current world. Originally created to compensate for the shutdown of the "JTN des Nuls", the show was part of an idea by Alain De Greef who wanted a French equivalent of "Spitting Image". Les Guignols de l'info have an important place in French popular culture: the repetitive nature of quotations and stereotypes of puppets have made the features of caricature more popular than the person himself.

name: Blodsoffer
summary: Detective Berg has given up on his absent ex-cop father - until a double police murder forces them back together.

name: Plastic Beauty
summary: Welcome to Tohyama Cosmetic Surgery Clinic: Botox parties, secret VIP floors and shadow doctors. Now along comes a new surgeon who won't stay silent.

name: The Big Country Quest
summary: Fancy chancing an arm at bodging? Or at duck herding, goat milking or flax spinning? These are some of the rural crafts that contestants have to tackle in The Big Country Quest presented by Nick Owen.

name: Don't Blow the Inheritance
summary: Tim Vine hosts this ITV game show, where teams made up of two generations of the same family answer general knowledge questions to build up their inheritance prize fund. Parents complete against each other in the early rounds to build up the money and then the winning team play in the final, where their son or daughter have to try and hold onto the inheritance.

name: Die Adria
summary: Explores the Adriatic coastline, highlighting its vibrant local cultures, historic towns and breathtaking landscapes from Italy to Croatia.

name: Refúgio do Medo
summary:
Maria is a Portuguese woman who emigrates to Vestmannaeyjar, a small and remote island in Iceland, in search of a better life for herself and her teenage daughter, Bela.

Away from a past marked by domestic violence and deep secrets, she looks for freedom and a place to be herself.

Six months after her arrival, Maria is found lifeless. Her violent death shocks the isolated community and exposes the secrets everyone is keeping.

The investigation is placed in the hands of Soffía an Icelandic detective who, as she immerses in the investigation, faces her own crossroads, trying to balance professional duty and the ghosts of her past.

name: Age of Attraction
summary: When age is just a number, is it easier to find the one? Singles aged 22 to 60 date without revealing how old they are in this fascinating reality series.

name: Maiagare!
summary: Iwakura Mai lives with her parents Kota and Megumi and older brother Haruto. Her father Kota runs a small factory in Higashi Osaka, a district that is known for its craftsmen. Mai is shy and withdrawn. But when she visits her grandmother Shoko who lives on Nagasaki's Goto Islands which has a rich natural environment, she is entranced by the Baramon kites that catch the wind and soar high in the sky. Wanting to fly high in the sky like these kites, Mai's longing swells into a dream to become a pilot. Even though she works hard, the path to getting there is tougher than she had imagined. As Mai deepens her ties with the people living in her two hometowns of Higashi Osaka and Goto, her dream eventually takes a new form. She gathers enthusiastic friends to build a small electric plane that can fly to and from the islands. Her dream becomes a wing that carries everyone's dreams and takes off.

name: Bargain Holiday Secrets
summary:
Insiders from some of the world's biggest travel companies lift the lid on the tactics that shape our choices, from pricing strategies to marketing tricks.

The series uncovers the truth behind all-you-can-eat buffets, cruise drinks packages, airline dynamic pricing and the FOMO marketing tactics designed to push us into booking in haste. Their behind-the-scenes insights will empower holidaymakers to book better, travel smarter and spend less.

name: Sin City: The Real Las Vegas
summary: Tir Dhondy finds out how Las Vegas has reinvented itself to pull in a new generation of visitors - recasting the city away from gambling to the world's go-to destination for live entertainment.

name: Missing
summary: The story revolves around spirits who are unable to move on as they carry unresolved attachments from their lost lives. In order to truly depart from the world of the living, the truth behind their deaths must first be uncovered.

name: The Eternal White
summary: The silence between Ela and Jim is a memory of Kin's failed operation, his daughter, now unable to feel emotions. On his trip to the white planet, the ship suffers an accident. To survive, the group must cross the eternal and white desert of the planet to get to Atis, avoiding being captured by their wild creatures that react to their fears, pain and joys.

name: The Tank: Ultimate Weapon of World War II
summary: From the early concepts to the first tank prototype, we examine how the battlefields of WWI set the scene for the mechanised warfare of WWII.

name: Will You Be My Manager
summary: Japanese high schooler Hirose Hana dreams of becoming a manager for top pop groups. She transfers to Segi Art High School, a South Korean school that has produced some of the Korean entertainment industry's brightest stars. Her first few days are a success, and she soon strikes up a friendship with the handsome and popular aspiring singer Koo Eun Ho. But she soon discovers that egos at the school are fragile, and that her own success may be stoking resentment in others. Worse still, someone at the school has learned that she is harboring a secret – and threatens to make it public. Is disaster in the cards for her, or will her new friends help her fulfill her dreams at this highly competitive school?

name: Dino Aventuras
summary:
On board of Atlas, a flying ship, Dino, Kika, Lip and Cacau travel above the clouds in a magical universe, where imagination is the limit. The gang is always willing to get in an adventure to help their friends of this fantastic world.

During each episode, Dino's crew will find some floating islands where they'll discover adventures that reflex situations on a child's daily basis. On a ludic and energetic way, they'll handle their fears, learn how to share, see the power of friendship and much more!

name: Aynı Yağmur Altında
summary: Rosa, a young woman who has devoted her life to the struggle for human rights, whose world is turned upside down during a Gaza protest she attends in London. As she grapples with a serious illness and an unexpected personal quest, Rosa finds herself in Istanbul. There, her path crosses once again with Ali, a man she met for the first time at the same protest. The two quickly fall in love, but their relationship will become the catalyst for a devastating chain of events that neither of them could foresee.

name: Kagi no nai Yume wo miru
Lost Grail with Alice Roberts
summary:
Join Professor Alice Roberts on an adventure across Britain as she decodes the truth behind its Holy Grail legends, linking Arthurian lore, sacred relics and the Knights Templar.

From the Isle of Wight to Glastonbury, Oxford, London and Scotland, she'll meet passionate locals, unearth legends of sacred vessels and ancient cauldrons and investigate Arthur's grave where the trail takes an interesting turn.

Her quest culminates at the mysterious Rosslyn Chapel and with a controversial archaeological find.

name: Michael Jackson: The Trial
summary: With exclusive new footage, unheard audio tapes and insiders from Jackson's entourage and the police, this beautifully composed and gripping series narrates a tragic story of the decline of a genius and steps beyond the media circus of "the trial of the century" to ask profound questions about fame, race, and the American justice system.

name: Our Yorkshire Pub Rescue with Jon Richardson
summary: What do you do if you love pubs and Yorkshire…? Bring an old boozer back to life! Jon Richardson becomes a shareholder in Fadmoor Community Pub Limited to breathe life back into their historic local.

name: Eliminator
summary: Eliminator is a British children's game show where teams of three answer questions to advance through levels while avoiding a pursuing character called the Eliminator. Strategy and quick thinking determine how far teams progress and what prizes they win.

name: Domesday Detectives
summary: Paul Coia presents the programme and asks teams from all over the country 'Where is the smallest home in Britain?' and 'In which town would you be most likely to see people playing uppies and downies?' The answers to these questions and many more can be found on the amazing Domesday discs. All you wanted to know about Britain in the 80s is contained on two laser discs and teams compete to win this treasure trove of information.

name: The Ultimate Baking Championship
summary: The Ultimate Baking Championship tests the competitors on the core techniques that outstanding pastry chefs must master, from laminated dough and pâte à choux to chocolate work and sugar artistry. Duff Goldman is joined every week on the judging panel by a baking legend to determine who has the skill, vision and endurance to rise above the rest and who will leave the competition. In the end, only one pastry chef will be named the Ultimate Baking Champion and win the $50,000 grand prize.

name: Halloween Bakeshop
summary: Hosted by Canadian actress and comedian Lauren Ash, this frightfully fun baking showdown will see eight talented competitors face off in a high-stakes competition for a chance to taste sweet victory, taking home the title of Halloween Bakeshop champion and a $25,000 prize.

name: Long Story Short
summary: Long Story Short is the result of a brand-new talent initiative from BBC Writers, created to shine a light on the next generation of UK screen talent. Spanning all four nations of the UK, Long Story Short pairs fresh writing and directing voices with local production companies to develop authored, ambitious short films. The result is a slate of seven remarkable short films, each one a testament to the energy, imagination and craft of the teams behind them. Long Story Short champions homegrown storytelling, amplifying voices from every corner of the country, and providing a platform for fresh perspectives that reflect the richness and diversity of the UK today.

name: Built in Love
summary: Soul is a skilled architect. Xinxin is a successful Feng Shui master. When these two women with polar opposite personalities are hired to build a house together for its homeowners, a battle between them ensues. But will there be space for love to bloom?

name: Fulfill
summary: From college sweethearts to lifelong partners, Pafun and Aioon build a loving, devoted life together—dreaming of a family that seems just out of reach. When Pafun's longing for motherhood deepens, their hope grows around the promise of adopting a child someday. Everything changes when their best friend, Nubnueng, returns unexpectedly and brings a life-altering opportunity. As love, loss, and responsibility collide, the couple must navigate heartbreak, resilience, and the challenges of becoming new parents. Fulfill is a tender, emotional journey that celebrates chosen family and the power of love to complete what life leaves unfinished.

name: AI Girl
summary: One day, a package arrives at quirky introvert Gen's doorstop. When she opens the package, she discovers a truly human-like robot, beautiful like the girl of Gen's dreams. While trying to find a way to send the robot back, Gen accidentally hits a button that has the robot opening her eyes and coming to life. With the beautiful, flirtatious, playful and sexy robot by her side, Gen is completely swayed and decides to keep her, giving her the name Ai.

name: The Last Case
summary: Could this be an accident, or perhaps it's a murder?

name: Between Sighs
summary: The plot centers on Laura, a Brazilian woman in search of herself, and Carisa, a Thai woman who finds refuge, in a romantic adventure that unfolds across different cultures and oceans. Marina, a Brazilian woman seeking to rediscover herself, and Nam, a Thai woman wanting to escape the pressures of her life, meet at a sanctuary in Thailand.

name: Love After Addiction
summary: Once an award-winning actor, Yoki sees his career collapse after being entangled in scandals—and is plagued by severe insomnia. While filming a reality show on a remote island, he unexpectedly reunites with his high school classmate Yang Meng, now a rescue team leader. To his surprise, the moment he sleeps beside Yang Meng, his long-suffering insomnia disappears. Using "sleep aid" as an excuse, Yoki launches a series of calculated pursuits, trying to get closer to the emotionally guarded Yang Meng. Yet through encounters that are planned, accidental, and uncontrollable, his feelings shift—from loving to sleep with someone, to loving the person he sleeps with. As the dreamlike reality show draws to an end, the two are forced to face a real test. Only then do they realise that in this so-called trap of love, they've already become hopelessly addicted to each other.

name: Katie Pavlich Tonight
summary: Katie Pavlich Tonight offers a conservative take on the day's events while welcoming all viewpoints. The goal: cutting through left-right bias in pursuit of plain facts and honest analysis.

name: Jesse Weber Live
summary: A fresh, fast-paced, and often unexpected take on the day's headlines, diving into the biggest stories through the lens of an expert in legal affairs.

name: Frontline: Our Soldiers Facing Putin
summary: Europe's on a knife edge. The battle to deter Putin has begun. Behind the scenes with NATO's troops, support teams and commanders through 2025, as they prepare for a war that seems closer by the day.

name: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
Maryoku Yummy
summary: Maryoku Yummy invites you to Nozomu, the magical land where Wishes become real.

name: The Interrogator
summary: The Interrogator centers on Conrad Henry, former MI6 agent, and his elite team. When conventional methods have failed, Henry's quirky charm, superior intellect, and mind-bending behavioral maneuvers make him the only man able to lockpick the minds of the world's most dangerous criminals.

name: The Morning Show with Sanam Baloch
Algojo
summary: Zar, an ANJELO, finds his father attacked by a mysterious man. Clues point to a group of executioners. To uncover the truth and exact revenge, Zar goes undercover and infiltrates a secret organization fraught with danger and betrayal.

name: E4 Mafia
summary: Four Specialists sham their way through life in the 82nd Airborne through back door favors, tactical acquisition, and CQ racketeering.

name: Phoebe & Jay
summary: Follow the adventures of 6-year-old fraternal twins Phoebe and Jay Yarber, who live with their family in the fantastical Tobsy Towers.

name: Careless
summary:
When Scottish backpacker Robbie finds himself in Sydney, he is determined to become a live-in carer for a notorious rock'n'roll legend, Mike, who has been diagnosed with multiple sclerosis. To his delight, he nails the interview and gets the gig. 

But, as he grows closer to Mike, he also grows closer to Mike's wife Angela, and becomes a confidante to both Mike and Angela. As Robbie integrates himself further in their relationship, it becomes clear there's something in Robbie's past which may put Mike and Angela in serious danger.

name: Mysterious and Absurd Cases of the Tang Dynasty
summary: In the glorious Kaiyuan era of the Tang Dynasty, beneath the prosperity of Chang'an lies a series of mysterious cases. Folk investigator Shentu Baiqi joins forces with Yao Yuan, the Deputy Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, and Mu Guiyi. Together, they unravel multiple bizarre incidents, from ghost infant rituals and coffin pressings to haunted towns, murderous puppets, and wife-pawning contracts. Peeling away layers of power, desire, and obsession, they seek truth before the dead and pursue justice in the silent shadows...

name: Agent P Under C
summary: Perry the Platypus, returns as his alter ego Agent P; he takes on a new undercover mission to stop animal enemies from rival spy organization A.N.A.T.H.E.M.A.: the Alliance of Nefarious Animals That Has an Exceptionally Memorable Acronym.

name: The Haunting Maid
summary: An, a scheming maid, plots revenge for her sister. She fabricates haunting incidents within the wealthy Chen family, and with the help of a Feng Shui Master, infiltrates their home to settle scores with her enemies. Yuan Youzhen, the Chens' brother-in-law, teams up with An to reclaim his lost family fortune. But An seduces Chen Zhengbang to reach her goal. Arrogant and self-righteous, Yuan tries to win her over with his morals—only to fall deeply in love with her instead.

name: Fall in Love Again
summary: Star actress Chu Jingxi quits for love, only to be betrayed by her fiancé, Qi Siqin. She exposes him at their wedding and walks away, but her career soon hits rock bottom. With her agent and bestie Yangyang pushing her forward, Jingxi starts her own production company. Superfan He Zheng stays by her side, while business tycoon Fu Sinian steps in with major backing and open affection. Yet as Jingxi fights her way back with He Zheng, sparks quietly grow between them. Just as her new project launches, Qi Siqin leaks her private photos, whipping the public into a frenzy. After a short reset, Jingxi faces it head-on, taking control of the narrative and winning back her career.

name: Field Generals: History of the Black Quarterback
summary: Field Generals: History of the Black Quarterback documents the stories of the trailblazing and pioneering quarterbacks who transformed the game—from the AFL-NFL merger through the turn of the century. By placing their journeys in full historical and social context, the series reveals how politics, culture, and race shaped both their struggles and their triumphs.

name: Großstadtrevier
summary: Großstadtrevier depicts everyday police work in the Hamburg district of St. Pauli and the neighborhood, focusing on the officers of the fictional 14th Police Station/PK14 (until season 23, the 14th Police Precinct). The plot essentially consists of three sub-areas.

name: How NOT To Hire A Hitman
summary: How Not To Hire A Hitman is a true crime series that looks at people who make the ill-advised decision to hire out a murder, and the even more ill-advised decisions they make to get themselves caught.

name: The Practical Guide to Love
summary: Blind dates seem like the most efficient way to meet someone. So Ui-yeong, still single despite yearning for love, decides to seek romance through blind dates. After a few attempts, two very different men step into her life—Tae-seop, quietly attentive, and Ji-su, playful and refreshing—leading her on an unexpected journey toward understanding what love truly means.

name: Duet of Shadows
summary: Qin Xin and Lin Lan, two very different girls, repeatedly solved strange cases and became detectives. They also gradually broke the knot and became best friends.

name: Catching Up With the Royals
summary:
Catching Up With the Royals is a brand-new weekly visualised podcast for 5, offering audiences a smart, entertaining and always-curious look at the royal family.

Every week Reverend Richard Coles and royal journalist Emily Andrews deep dive on the latest royal news, inside whispers and intel from their royal sources to lift the lid on what life is really like behind palace walls. They'll also look back on key moments from history that informed the way the monarchy is today and answer viewer/listener questions about the royal topics they've always wanted to know more about.

The show delivers fresh perspective and behind-the-scenes access into Britain's most famous institution with warmth, humour and genuine insider knowledge bringing viewers and listeners closer than ever to the monarchy both past and present.

name: Black and Jewish America: An Interwoven History
summary: Black and Jewish America: An Interwoven History is a four-part series tracing the rich, complex relationship between Black and Jewish Americans — defined by solidarity and strained by division. Drawn together by racism and antisemitism, they forged civic and cultural bonds, especially during the civil rights era. The series explores both the challenges and enduring promise of that alliance.

name: DIY Dungeon
summary: A DIY show, but make it spicy. Joey Mills and Fantasia Royale Gaga are serving camp, construction, and kink in their new OUTtv series 'DIY Dungeon' — from basement redo to sex-positive lessons and all the chaos in between. Watch the trailer!

name: Infinite Cycle of Love
summary: Xiao Ling, the Empress of Li Kingdom, was born into a distinguished military family. For love, she laid down her armor and married Emperor Li Yunxi. Yet after their marriage, she is met only with coldness and suspicion from him. Deeply wounded, Xiao Ling ultimately cuts her hair to repudiate her husband, but is murdered while fleeing the imperial palace. At the moment of her death, she discovers that she has been reborn—returning to one month earlier. Determined to sever all ties with Li Yunxi and change her fate, Xiao Ling struggles to escape their entanglement, only to die again and again due to various unforeseen accidents. Through four cycles of death and rebirth, she gradually realizes that countless misunderstandings stand between her and Li Yunxi. The injuries she believed he inflicted in her previous life were, in truth, acts of secret protection, and the real mastermind behind everything is someone else entirely. After reconciling with Li Yunxi and joining forces with him to uncover the truth and eliminate the true culprit, Xiao Ling resolves to be with him at all costs. However, she then learns that Li Yunxi is gravely ill and nearing death. The rebirths that gave her a second chance were purchased at the price of his life—Li Yunxi burned his own lifespan to light the Lingxi Incense. In the end, fate decrees that only one of them can survive.

name: All In
summary: All In follows a Flemish and a Dutch family who spend their vacation at a Spanish all-inclusive resort. What starts as a dream vacation quickly turns into a battle for the perfect vacation experience. As if that wasn't enough, their carefree stay is turned upside down by a gang of criminals and the hotel staff clearly needs a leave of absence themselves.

name: Eragon
summary: In Eragon, when destiny selects an ordinary teenager to become the first Dragon Rider in over a hundred years, he must forge an unbreakable bond with his dragon, master ancient magic, and challenge the mad king who destroyed the Riders.

name: Agios Paisios, Apo ta Farasa ston Ourano
summary:
The story begins with the birth of Saint Paisios, born Arsenios Eznepidis, in Farasa, Cappadocia. A few days before the people of Farasa abandoned their village, he was baptized by Saint Arsenios the Cappadocian, where he took his name "to leave a monk at his feet". After the Treaty of Lausanne, the family of little Arsenios was uprooted and took the path of refuge to Greece. Together with his family, they temporarily settled in Corfu, but soon they would depart for Konitsa, Epirus.

His grandmother and mother transmitted their faith and love for the Lord. He grew up with stories about Saint Arsenios and the desire to follow the monastic life flared up in him from an early age. In 1945 he joined the army where he served as a radio operator. Upon his discharge, he visited Mount Athos. However, he soon returned to Konitsa for family reasons and remained there for three years. He left for Mount Athos permanently in March 1953 and ended up at the Esphigmenou Monastery. After three years, he found himself at the Philotheou Monastery, where he became a monk and took the name "Paisios". He sent a photograph of himself to his mother with which he bid her farewell and told her that he would now have the Virgin Mary as his mother.

name: ІстФак
summary:
History is not only facts, but also questions that generations seek answers to.

In the new podcast IstFak (Ukrainain: ІстФак; Faculty of History), Volodymyr Viatrovych, PhD in History and director of the Ukrainian Institute of National Remembrance, and Yaryna Sizyk, folklorist and member of the band ShchukaRyba, explore the most pressing historical topics, debunk myths, and uncover connections you never knew existed.

History is more important than ever.

previousepisode.name: Хто фінансував УПА та чи виконали повстанці поставлені завдання

name: Daemons of the Shadow Realm
summary: Yuru, a young hunter who lives in a small village deep in the mountains, hunts wild game and leads a humble life with Asa, his younger twin sister. Their peaceful lives are torn apart when a dragon's roar echoes across the sky. What secrets lurk within their village? What fate awaits them? Enter a breathtaking mystical fantasy as exciting Daemon battles intertwine the mysterious and supernatural.

name: Особенности национальной кухни
summary: Mikhail Stognienko and his viewers will explore Russia as it exists far beyond the Moscow Ring Road. Each episode will be an expedition to a different city, where Mikhail will join foreign haute cuisine chef Pierre Carbonara. Together, they will bring back the crown jewel of Pierre's restaurant—a spectacular and expensive dish that costs thousands of rubles in the capital. Will residents of the regions, accustomed to hearty cuisine, be able to appreciate this culinary delight? Their initial reaction, honest and uncompromising, will put many things into perspective.

name: Murder in Glitterball City
summary:
The city of Louisville, Kentucky is known for the beauty of its historic Victorian architecture and birthplace of the mirrored glitterball. It also has a reputation for being one of America's most haunted neighborhoods and is the backdrop for a dark tale of murder, lies, and deceit. With a uniquely colorful cast of local residents as tour guides, the two-part documentary explores the shifting landscape of a grisly murder, the toxic relationship of two ex-lovers, a vulnerable victim, and the unreliable accounts of flawed individuals on trial for their lives.

Inspired by the non-fiction book "A Dark Room in Glitter Ball City" by David Dominé, the film chronicles a 2010 murder case that starts with a 911 phone call that leads police to the gruesome discovery of a body buried in the basement of a Victorian mansion. As two men face police interrogators, a story emerges of twisted liaisons. Each partner points an accusatory finger at the other and their respective accounts brim with glaring inconsistencies and false allegations. As two separate murder trials unfold, key pieces of video evidence emerge, subverting expectations about suspects Joey Banis and Jeffrey Mundt.

name: Escape to Homestay
summary: Top, the owner of a bankrupt pub in the heart of Bangkok. decides to say goodbye to the city and take comfort in his grandmother Thap, the owner of a homestay in the nearby province of Nakhon Nayok. With him, Top drags his close friends Kan, a flight attendant recently put on leave, and Film, a photographer who's lost his passion to help with the homestay. When the gang arrives, Grandma Thap introduces them to P'Ter, a government officer favoured by the locals. The three begin working at the homestay and get to know more of the locals: Tao, Ter's younger sister who's fled home and her parents' expectations, Jen, a café owner close with Ter, and TikToker Bell.

name: The Great Icelandic Swim with Ross Edgley
summary: Sixty-foot waves, nosy killer whales, hypothermia, tongue rot. Ultra-athlete Ross Edgley attempts to swim all the way around Iceland - 1000 miles of icy water.

previousepisode.name: Land of the Dragon and Giant

name: Roman Empire by Train with Alice Roberts
summary: Alice embarks on her most ambitious journey to date, in search of the Roman Empire, travelling 1300 miles through Italy, France and Spain to discover the origins and secrets of Rome's success.

name: Let's FoQ: El reencuentro
summary: Special interview program to reminisce with the stars of the series about great anecdotes, the most iconic scenes, and how they experienced the success of 'FoQ' firsthand.

name: Morbo K - Chi salva una vita salva il mondo intero
summary: On the eve of the roundup of the Rome ghetto in 1943, the director of the Fatebenefratelli hospital, Professor Prati, saves several Jewish families by pretending that a contagious virus, known as Morbo K, exists in order to keep the Nazis away. Among the refugees is Silvia Calò, a young artist who falls in love with the doctor Pietro Prestifilippo. While Kappler betrays his promise of salvation and begins the deportations, the destinies of the protagonists intertwine in the most dramatic hours before the departure of the trains.

name: Morfonication
summary: Morfonication is a two-episode anime special focusing on the band "Morfonica". Set after BanG Dream! Season 3, it depicts the members reflecting on their identities, insecurities, and growth as a band. The story is self-contained, character-driven, and takes place within the main BanG Dream! continuity, but it does not advance the broader franchise plot.

name: Takeover Bid
summary: Bruce Forsyth presents Takeover Bid, a game show where the contestants are given prizes and then bid to take over those prizes from each other.

name: The Dinosaurs
summary: From the creators of Life on Our Planet, this new documentary series will tell the story of the rise and fall of the dinosaurs — where they came from, why they mattered, how they evolved and how they met their ultimate fate.

name: Too Young To Love
summary: Influenced by her mother from a young age, Yi Lan studied the cello and displayed remarkable talent. In her very first week of high school, encouraged by her childhood friend Tong Xiaole, she resolved to form her own musical trio. Driven by the goals of "defeating the school orchestra" and "performing at the annual campus festival," Yi Lan worked tirelessly, burning with the energy of a little sun. Her passion was infectious, inspiring Tong Xiaole to rekindle his own musical dreams. Amidst the melodious strains of the cello, the laughter of friends, and the tears of a young girl's secret heart, a skirt swirls and a spark of inspiration strikes. A young girl plays the movement of her youth, illuminating the world of a young boy in the process. A group of teenagers, meeting at the most beautiful age, use music and dreams to compose their most perfect summer.

name: How To Survive Without Me
summary: In the wake of matriarch Beverly's passing, the De Angelis family has begun to drift, unsure how to manage their complicated, evolving lives without her guidance. But in true Beverly fashion, she found a way to keep running the show from the beyond. Should they wish to experience Beverly's final work, the family must find the time — and make the effort — to remain connected, and be there for each other through all of life's challenges yet to come.

name: Yesterday Wife
summary: Phum is fed up with his wife and gets magical coins that bring him back to the past. He then marries his first love, but his old wife appears to be his lovely colleague.

name: Adam Richman Eats Italy
summary: Globally famous superfoodie Adam Richman is back with his next delicious adventure and this time he's in Italy.

name: Fleet of Time
summary: Five friends recount their good, bad and educational experiences of growing up in Bangkok in the 1980s. Win, Fang, Cheaw, King and Yae become best friends in high school. Win and Fang have feelings for each other. Cheaw has secretly liked Fang ever since he fell in love with her at first sight. At the end of high school, Cheaw goes to UK and Win and Fang goes to the same university. Win becomes very popular in campus and starts dating a beautiful girl, Alyn. Out of jealousy, Fang hangs out with a playboy. After Fang going through a hardship, Cheaw comes to take care of her but she refuses. However, she meets Cheaw again in France unexpectedly. Will she fall in love with Cheaw or get Win back?

name: Club Friday Hot Love Issue: New Story, Old Love
summary: Something peculiar begins to unfold; the ex-lover appears to be afraid of something in her own room and requests to sleep in our room. To make things worse, my boyfriend's mother still holds strong affection for her son's ex-lover and welcomes her into their home.

name: Club Friday Hot Love Issue: One Night Stand
summary: Khwanphon, a modern high school teacher, doesn't believe in long-term relationships or even love. She leads a secret lifestyle, enjoying one-night stands without any commitments. However, she finds herself involved with three different men: Kornkit, a gentlemanly figure who is the son of the school owner where Khwanphon works; Time, a colleague who has been pursuing her for a long time but has never been reciprocated; and Mac, a playboy who desires more than just one-night stands with Khwanphon. The story becomes complicated when Khwanphon decides to marry one of the three men. However, her turbulent past catches up with her, leading to unexpected consequences.

name: Club Friday Theory of Love: No Such Thing as Coincidence
summary: A shy, soft-spoken single woman who struggles with socializing has never had a boyfriend. One day, a seemingly chance encounter brings her face-to-face with a charming, good-looking man. From this initial meeting, the man begins pursuing her in earnest, sweeping her off her feet. He seems to know everything about her, constantly surprising her with thoughtful gestures. She starts to believe that this man is not just a coincidence, but the soulmate she's been waiting her entire life for. What starts as a romantic tale soon turns into heartbreaking drama. Another woman appears, weirdly similar in appearance and personality, revealing a shocking truth: they're dating the same man. But this man is no soulmate—he's a con artist. Every coincidence precisely planned. Using social media, he searched for women like her: single, inexperienced, socially reserved. It's now time for the two women to join forces and take down the man who fabricated coincidences to prey on them.

name: The Sandy Effect
summary: Volunteer teacher Sandy believes in the message "no child left behind." She makes it her mission to help her underprivileged young students discover their potential and make sure they don't fall out of the system.

name: The Lady and Her Lovers
summary: Thongprakai or "Thongdee" is a girl who goes to live in Bangkok in search for a better life. Despite getting involved with several doting men, sustained happiness alludes her. Their interest seems shallow, and she must ponder whether her beauty is more of a curse than a blessing.

name: The Thirsty Thirty
summary: Welcome to your thirties. Are you ready to step into the dreams you've envisioned?

name: L/over – ikuisesti minun
summary: When Roosa meets Juha, a charismatic author, they fall head over heels in love and seem to have found everything they ever wanted in each other—until the love story takes a dark turn.

name: Si es martes, es asesinato
summary: A diverse group of Spanish tourists on a planned trip, a once-grand hotel crumbling into ruins, and a handful of dark secrets converge during a week-long holiday in Lisbon. When one of the travelers is found dead the day after their arrival, four of the others set out to investigate who the killer might be—and whether it could even be someone within their own group. This team of devoted true-crime and mystery-novel fans will have to face the police, a roster of suspects, the threat of being expelled from the trip, and their own hidden truths as the days slip away before they have to leave Lisbon.

name: The Shadow Sovereign
summary: Princess Zhao Yang, Li Shu, is born to a low-ranking concubine and grows up in the Cold Palace, where she endures years of neglect because of her mother's humble status. Through her intelligence and political acumen, she earns a place in the Crown Prince's faction. Yet after leaving the Cold Palace, she becomes nothing more than a pawn in his political game. Three years later, Emperor Bing Qian reforms the imperial examination system by reviving the Xiao Lian recommendation system to curb the influence of the powerful noble clans. At the banquet honoring the newly crowned scholars, Li Shu is publicly impeached by Shen Xiao, the top scholar from a humble background. With the emperor quietly orchestrating events behind the scenes, Shen Xiao leads the rising commoner officials in challenging the aristocratic families and their monopoly on power. As Li Shu and Shen Xiao confront each other, they become locked in a fierce political rivalry. Determined to break free from her loveless marriage and the Crown Prince's control, Li Shu uses her public clashes with Shen Xiao as a cover while secretly cultivating the influence of talented commoners. Together, they gradually weaken the corrupt Crown Prince's faction and reshape the empire's balance of power.

name: Talking Royals
summary: Charlene White hosts a round-up of royal news with expert analysis from ITV News Royal Editor Chris Ship, ITV News royal expert Lizzie Robinson and a host of guests.

name: Money Honey
summary: Stories from a market community of Jae Nam. Wit opens an organic vegetables stand in front of the pork butchery of Hia Tang. Wit meets Money, Hia Tang's daughter. Money dislikes Wit from some trouble pasts in the university. But as she is a vegetarian, Wit's vegetable stand becomes her favorite.

name: Sweet Secret
summary: Get ready to practice your investigative skills because of three high school spy girls, Sherbet, Chocco, and Yogurt, who have to disguise themselves to investigate drug cases at St. Butus School. In addition to the case, the agents also have to deal with the club's seniors who are constantly disturbing.

name: The Surgeon
summary:
For the first time, this series reveals exactly what life is really like as a surgeon: from the high-pressure world of the operating theatre, where someone's life is literally in your hands, to the consulting room where news must be broken, both good and bad, to the everyday ups and downs of life at home.

Each episode follows a different surgeon as they juggle these very different worlds making life changing decisions on a daily basis.

It's a dramatic and deeply personal series that gets under the skin of surgeons like never before.

name: Love Through Time
summary: In the Emerald City, a land steeped in civilization, yet still harboring secrets, Princess Kannika mysteriously disappears. Before the Prince of Bagan arrives to inquire, a photograph surfaces showing a young woman in traditional Thai costume on a stage in Bangkok. The woman's face is has an undeniable resemblance to Princess Kannika, causing panic and fear as people suddenly see her appear. At the same time, the CEO of a renowned advertising company happens to drive by and sees the woman in traditional Thai attire running in front of his car. He brakes suddenly and decides to take her home, believing she may have suffered a brain injury in the car accident. The story becomes big news when a government agency wants Kannika to model for their advertisement. Kannika has no choice; the government is like family to her. She accepts the job in exchange for the government helping her return to the Emerald City.

name: The Port
summary:
Behind the scenes at Scotland's largest and busiest maritime hub - the Port of Aberdeen - a critical gateway linking the nation to the North Sea's vital trade routes and industries. We follow the everyday heroes who work tirelessly to keep 7,600 meters of quayside operational against the odds as they welcome over 7000 vessels annually, processing more than three million tons of cargo.

In the Port of Aberdeen, no day is the same. Every day brings fresh challenges. We capture the riveting day-to-day lives of the hundred-strong support staff - from the daring pilots who leap between moving vessels to the unsung heroes whose precision keeps two vast harbours humming with activity.

This series captures the scale, skill, and sheer determination that keeps this vital artery of British industry pumping 24/7, 365 days a year.

name: The Interns
summary: A group of newly graduated doctors begin their internships at Maharak Hospital. Lin hopes to impress Dr. Thida, the country's most famous brain surgeon so that she'll pick her as her protégé. Pawin is the pillar of his family. With his family facing financial troubles, he works hard to take amazing care of all his patients. Emmi is the heiress of an importing business that moves medical equipment. She means to make connections in order to profit from future business in the medical industry. Ket is chasing her dream of being a doctor who treats all patients equally, regardless of gender identity. Best has high ideals; he has a love for what is right. He became a doctor out of a desire to make changes in the system, wanting everyone to receive equal treatment. He doesn't want to see anyone die hopelessly as his little sister did.

name: Alice Roberts: Our Hospital Through Time
summary:
St Bartholomew's Hospital is one of the most extraordinary institutions in the world: the oldest hospital in Britain still operating on its original site, and today a global leader in cutting-edge medicine.

This series has unprecedented access to both its modern wards and its private archive – a unique collection spanning nearly 1,000 years of medical history, unseen anywhere else. Leading the series is Professor Alice Roberts, whose expertise as an anatomist and historian places her at the heart of this journey. From brutal early surgery to robot-assisted operations, she reveals how centuries of risk and innovation shaped modern medicine.

name: Once Upon a Time
summary: Pursuing his dream of becoming a screenwriter, twenty-seven-year-old Nathee invites his close friend Pharadon to write a script with him. He finds writing inspiration in the old poems hanging in a restaurant called Tram. These poems were written by the restaurant's owner, Arak. After getting to know Arak, Nathee learns the story of how his first love began on the last day the tram ran. On the tram's final trip, Arak and his close friend Boriphat fell in love with the same girl, Mukda. After that day, the story of their love triangle began. The film script is the story of a love triangle, overlapping with the true story of Natthee, Pharadon, and Sokaew. Sokaew has fallen for Nathee, and Pharadon has fallen for Sokaew. However, Nathee doesn't think of Sokaew like that.

name: Cacau
summary: A captivating saga of family secrets, all sweetened by the irresistible taste of chocolate.

name: Hermanas, un Amor Compartido
summary: Rebeca and Mónica, two sisters who were always inseparable, supporting each other through thick and thin, despite their markedly opposite temperaments. Their bond shatters when a youthful mistake forever alters their lives. Rebeca is unjustly imprisoned and forced to leave her daughter, Aura, in a children's home, from where Mónica rescues her by adopting her. Years later, consumed by guilt for having been separated from her daughter, she decides to reclaim her. Thus begins a struggle between the sisters for Aura's love. Mónica, who has dedicated her youth to raising Aura, refuses to lose her and will do anything to keep her.

name: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown
summary: Marking the 40th anniversary of the unprecedented tragedy, Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown tells the powerful story of the world's worst nuclear disaster in four gripping episodes. Spanning the scope of the catastrophic collapse of the reactor, the Soviets' calculated cover-up, and the present-day fallout now intersecting with the war in Ukraine, the series reveals a tragedy still reverberating across history. Featuring revealing interviews with survivors speaking publicly for the first time, alongside rare insight into the CIA and Soviet responses, the series exposes a web of secrecy, miscalculation, and human cost. Astonishing new footage from inside the nuclear exclusion zone reveals how this scarred landscape is once again under siege as war encroaches on one of the most dangerous places on Earth.

name: Necromancer
summary: Growing up haunted by his father's mysterious disappearance, Singha gains extraordinary powers from magical tattoos after a deadly incident. With the guidance of an occult master, he must harness his new abilities to confront a corrupt politician wielding dark magic and protect his city.

name: L'Invisibile – La Cattura di Matteo Messina Denaro
summary: Colonel Lucio Gambera leads the ROS (Special Operations Group) in the hunt for mob boss Matteo Messina Denaro. After years of false leads, he receives an ultimatum from his commander: three months to capture the fugitive, otherwise the task will be entrusted to a new team. A race against time begins, filled with investigations, risks, and hidden truths.

name: 100 Days of Deception
summary: Set in Gyeongseong during the Japanese colonial period, the drama follows Ga Gyeong, the city's most talented pickpocket, who strikes a dangerous deal with the independence army and goes undercover at the Japanese Government-General of Joseon. Disguised as an employee, she is tasked with acting as a "fake spy" for just 100 days, but her mission slowly turns her into a real informant caught between survival, loyalty, and conviction.
